1.consolidated_definition: Socio de una empresa que tiene participación limitada en el manejo de los asuntos y en los beneficios. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Se producía a sabiendas de que era afuera, otra gente, la que principalmente se beneficiaba y que el grupo dominante criollo era sólo un junior partner
1.en_consolidated_definition: Associate of a company with limited participation in the management and benefits. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. It was produced knowingly that it was outside, other people, who mainly benefited, and that the dominant Creole group was only a junior partner.
